decisions.reason: The rotating-skip compact dumper builds directly on the firm's core construction vehicle know-how, so its own R&D can absorb market feedback and refine it at low risk.
The articulated dumper extends the established vehicle engineering and service base, which gives the firm the absorptive capacity to interpret results and adapt the product for customers.
The firm's underground vehicle experience and its own R&D help it learn in this distant rescue-vehicle niche, and long procurement cycles justify keeping it despite the slower feedback.
The multi-model telescopic loader line rests on core lifting and vehicle expertise and yields rich feedback for continuous improvement.
The material lift is close to the established offer and is documented as the most popular rental lift with a new large order, a clear success signal the firm can readily build on.

Although distant from the core offer, the mining loader shows strong quantified field performance (1,000 hours in 7 months), which gives the firm interpretable evidence to absorb and use for improving the product.
